name: Berodach-Baladan
bio: Berodach-Baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah after hearing he had been sick. Hezekiah proudly showed the envoys everything in his treasuries, armory, and storehouses, holding nothing back. Isaiah rebuked him for it, prophesying that everything Hezekiah had shown them, and more, would one day be carried off to Babylon, and Hezekiah's own descendants would become eunuchs in the Babylonian king's palace (2 Kings 20:12-19).
